title: Apples
style: lo-fi ASMR, minimalistic, melodic, hypnotic, vocal, relaxing, gentle, rhythmic, world, soft, emotional, soothing, sleep, ambient, slow, deep, breathy, warm, female vocals
lyrics:
[Verse]
Red is the color of my apple
When you peel it with a knife
The one I used to sleep with
Every single night

[Pre-Chorus]
Blue is the color of my apple
When it goes bad
But blue is also the color
Of the sky I wish I had

[Chorus]
[gritty singing]
How do you sleep at night?
Do you sleep with one eye open
In case I turn out the light?
Or do you sleep with a woman?
How do you sleep at night?
Do you sleep with one eye open
In case I turn out the light?
Or do you sleep with a woman?

[Verse]
Blue is the color of my apple
When you leave it in the sun
Green is the color of my apple
When it's finally gone

[Pre-Chorus]
Pink is the color of my apple
When it's soft and sweet
Yellow is the color of my apple
When it rots on the street

[Chorus]
How do you sleep at night?
Do you sleep with one eye open
In case I turn out the light?
Or do you sleep with a woman?
How do you sleep at night?
Do you sleep with one eye open
In case I turn out the light?
Or do you sleep with a woman?
Or do you sleep with a woman?
